g.text: SOFTWARE ENGINEER :: CS @ PURDUE :: CLASS OF 2028
Hello! I am a software engineer studying CS at Purdue. My focus is building real
products that people actually use. I care about shipping practical applications
that bring genuine value to everyday users, with my own personal twists.
With 5+ years of development experience, I build web applications, interactive
tools, and games. I am currently seeking a software engineering internship where
I can help build and scale products that make a difference.
> philosophy ..... real products, things people actually use
LANGUAGES c c++ c# java python js r
